title: Barua na zawadi ambazo wanafunzi waliniletea zilinifurahisha

text.The letters and gifts students brought m: Barua na zawadi ambazo wanafunzi waliniletea zilinifurahisha
text.One thing that made me happy, working at: Jambo moja ambalo lilinifurahisha, nikifanya kazi katika shule ya lugha huko Clark, ni barua na zawadi nilizopokea kutoka kwa wanafunzi.
text.There is one letter among all the ones I: Kuna barua moja kati ya zote nilizopata kutoka kwa wanafunzi ambayo ilinifurahisha zaidi.
text.The kind students, whether Korean or Jap: Wanafunzi wema, wawe Wakorea au Wajapani au Watawai au Wachina, wakati mwingine waliniletea zawadi. Wangesema "hapa, hii ni ukumbusho, ukumbusho wa Kijapani" au "lazima uikose Japan, sivyo?" na uniletee yatsuhashi, au unipe vitafunio vya Kikorea visivyo vya kawaida.
text.Getting souvenirs like that made me a li: Kupata zawadi kama hiyo kulinifurahisha kidogo.
text.Clark is called the California of Southe: Clark inaitwa California ya Kusini-mashariki mwa Asia, na inaonekana kama hiyo
text.I worked standing up, and people started: nilifanya kazi nikisimama, na watu wakaanza kunizungumza
text.My luck seems to go up from age 24: Bahati yangu inaonekana kupanda kutoka umri wa miaka 24
text.Of everything students gave me, what mad: Kati ya kila kitu ambacho wanafunzi walinipa, kilichonifurahisha zaidi ni herufi ☺️
text.Some students also brought me souvenirs,: Baadhi ya wanafunzi pia waliniletea zawadi, iwe ni Wakorea, Wajapani, WaTaiwani au Wachina. Mmoja alileta yatsuhashi, tamu ya mdalasini kutoka Kyoto, akisema "Lazima uikose Japan, sivyo?" Wengine walinipa vitafunio vya Kikorea visivyo vya kawaida.
